title: Hero (1984)
desc: Krishna follows Vikram in search of a treasure. He wants to find out who killed Vikram. He makes a new friend,but later learns that he is the culprit.

title: Namo Venkatesa
desc: Ramana, a ventriloquist, falls in love with Pooja, the daughter of a rich factionist, while on tour in Europe. When she is forced to marry against her wish, Ramana and her uncle decide to rescue her.

title: Iddaru Mitrulu
desc: Best friends, Vijay and Anitha, get married to the people they love. However, when the latter faces problems in her life, Vijay gives up his married life to help her.

title: 100percent Love
desc: Balu and his cousin Mahalakshmi fall for each other but separate due to ego clashes. Years later, when their grandmother falls ill, they are forced to confront each other.

title: Sakthi
desc: Aishwarya, the daughter of a politician, meets a guide, Shakti, on a trip. Initially, she dislikes him because of his behaviour but later falls in love with him after he saves her from gangsters.
